```{r SNR and Trial Size PLOT}
# variance of predictor
varX <- 1

L <- 10^(seq(0, 5, length.out = 200)) 

SNR <- c(0.5, 0.05, 0.005, 0.0005)

df <- expand.grid(L = L, SNR = SNR)
df$rec_ratio <- with(df, SNR / (SNR + 1 / (varX * L)))
df$SNR <- factor(df$SNR, levels = sort(unique(df$SNR), decreasing = TRUE))

minor_breaks_log10 <- function(lims) {
  lo <- floor(log10(lims[1]))
  hi <- ceiling(log10(lims[2]))
  as.numeric(outer(1:9, 10^(lo:(hi-1)), `*`))
}

gamma_labels <- function(values) {
  s <- format(as.numeric(values), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  s <- sub("0+$", "", s)   # remove trailing zeros
  s <- sub("\\.$", "", s)  # remove trailing decimal point if needed
  expr_strings <- paste0(
    'paste(gamma[1]^2, " = ", gamma[2]^2, " = ", "', s, '")'
  )
  parse(text = expr_strings)
}

ggplot(df, aes(x = L, y = rec_ratio, color = factor(SNR), group = SNR)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = 10^(0:6), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1), 
    minor_breaks = minor_breaks_log10) +
  scale_color_discrete(labels = gamma_labels) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "b") +
  labs(x = "Trial Size", y = expression("Recovery Ratio (" * hat(r) /r* ")"), 
       color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3), axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(1, 0.05), legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.1), color = NA)
  )
```

```{r }
gamma12_labels_expr <- function(values, gamma1 = 0.05) {
  g1 <- format(gamma1, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  g1 <- sub("0+$", "", g1); g1 <- sub("\\.$", "", g1)

  s  <- format(as.numeric(values), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  s  <- sub("0+$", "", s);  s  <- sub("\\.$", "", s)
  expr_strings <- paste0(
    'paste(gamma[1]^2, " = ", "', g1,
    '", ", ", gamma[2]^2, " = ", "', s, '")'
  )
  parse(text = expr_strings)
}
```

```{r PP Number and Width plot}
# variance of predictor
varX <- 1

I <- 10^(seq(1, 4, length.out = 200))
L <- 101
t_rel <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

SNR1 <- 0.04
SNR2 <- 0.04

att_factor <- sqrt((SNR1 / (SNR1 + 1 / (varX * L))) * (SNR2 / (SNR2 + 1 / (varX * L))))
exp_factor <- 1/att_factor

df <- expand.grid(I = I, L = L, SNR1 = SNR1, SNR2 = SNR2, t_rel=t_rel, attenuation = att_factor, expansion = exp_factor)
df$est_rel <- with(df, t_rel * attenuation)
df$lower <- with(df, tanh(atanh(est_rel) - 1.96 / sqrt(I - 3)))
df$upper <- with(df, tanh(atanh(est_rel) + 1.96 / sqrt(I - 3)))
df$CI_Width <- with(df, abs(upper - lower))

ggplot(df, aes(x = I, y = CI_Width, color = factor(t_rel), group = t_rel)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_log10( breaks = 10^(1:4), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    minor_breaks = function(lims) {
      lo <- floor(log10(lims[1]))
      hi <- ceiling(log10(lims[2]))
      as.numeric(outer(1:9, 10^(lo:(hi - 1)), `*`))
    }
  ) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "b") +
  labs(x = "Number of individuals (I)", y = "95% CI Width", color = expression("True Reliability (" * r * ")")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(1, 1), legend.justification = c("right", "top"), legend.title.align = 0.5,
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.1), color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3), axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt")
  )
```

```{r Simulation and Modeling, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(8)

# --- Parameters that remain fixed across runs ---
N_subj <- 100
n_per  <- 1000
sd_c1 <- 0.01
sd_c2 <- 0.01
# sd_c1 <- 0.1118034
# sd_c2 <- 0.03535534
sigma_eps <- 0.5
beta0 <- 0                    
beta_c1 <- 0.00 
beta_c2 <- 0.00

rho_vals <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

# pred <- rnorm(n_per, mean = 0, sd = 3)   

pred <- rnorm(n_per)

# --- Loop over rho_true values ---
for (rho_true in rho_vals) {
  tol <- 0.001
  repeat {
    b_mat <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_subj, mu = c(0,0),
                           Sigma = matrix(c(sd_c1^2, rho_true*sd_c1*sd_c2,
                                            rho_true*sd_c1*sd_c2, sd_c2^2), 2, 2))
    r_emp <- cor(b_mat[,1], b_mat[,2])
    if (abs(r_emp - rho_true) <= tol) break
  }

  # --- enforce sample SDs (preserves r_emp) ---
  b_mat[,1] <- (b_mat[,1] - mean(b_mat[,1])) / sd(b_mat[,1]) * sd_c1
  b_mat[,2] <- (b_mat[,2] - mean(b_mat[,2])) / sd(b_mat[,2]) * sd_c2
  cat(sprintf("empirial sd1 = %.3f, empirial sd1 = %.3f\n",sd(b_mat[,1]), sd(b_mat[,2])))
  
  # Simulate hierarchical data
  sim_list <- lapply(1:N_subj, function(i){
    c1 <- c(rep(1, n_per), rep(0, n_per))
    c2 <- c(rep(0, n_per), rep(1, n_per))
    pred_all <- rep(pred, 2)
    
    mu <- beta0 + (beta_c1 + b_mat[i,1]) * (pred_all * c1) +
                   (beta_c2 + b_mat[i,2]) * (pred_all * c2)
    
    y <- rnorm(n_per * 2, mu, sigma_eps)
    data.frame(subj_id = factor(i), y, pred = pred_all, c1, c2)
  })
  
  dat <- do.call(rbind, sim_list)
  
  
  cor_test <- cor(beta_c1 + b_mat[,1], beta_c2 + b_mat[,2])
  cat(sprintf("rho_true = %.2f, empirical corr = %.3f\n", rho_true, cor_test))
  
  # --- Save dataset ---
  csv_path <- sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/data/dat_rho_%s.csv", rho_true)
  write.csv(dat, csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved data for rho =", rho_true, "->", csv_path, "\n")

  
##### Comment this part out, when run the codes #####
  # # --- Fit the brms model ---
  
  # fit <- brm(
  #   y ~ 1 + c2 + pred + (0 + pred:c1 + pred:c2 | subj_id),
  #   data   = dat,
  #   family = gaussian(),
  #   prior = c(
  #     prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
  #     prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
  #     prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
  #     prior(exponential(2), class = sigma),
  #     prior(lkj(1), class = cor)
  #   ),
  #   chains = 4,
  #   iter = 2000,
  #   warmup = 1000,
  #   cores = 4,
  #   backend = "cmdstanr",
  #   silent = 0,
  #   file = sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/model/simulation_rel_%s", rho_true)
  # )
  
##### Comment this part out, when run the codes #####

  cat("Finished fitting model for rho =", rho_true, "\n\n")
}

rho_vals <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

naive_df <- map_dfr(rho_vals, function(rho) {
  dat <- read.csv(sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/data/dat_rho_%s.csv", rho))
  varX <- sd(dat$pred)^2

  # per-subject×condition slope, SE, residual sigma, nobs
  per <- dat %>%
    group_by(subj_id, c1) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      m <- lm(y ~ 0 + pred, data = .x)
      s <- summary(m)
      tibble(
        estimate = unname(coef(m)["pred"]),
        se       = s$coefficients["pred", "Std. Error"],
        sigma    = s$sigma,
        nobs     = nobs(m),
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # View(per)

  # correlation of slopes between c1=0 and c1=1
  wide <- per %>%
    dplyr::select(subj_id, c1, estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = c1, values_from = estimate, names_prefix = "c1_") %>%
    drop_na(c1_0, c1_1)

  ct <- cor.test(wide$c1_0, wide$c1_1)

  # pooled within-subject sigma across all subj×cond
  # pooled_sigma2 <- with(per, weighted.mean(sigma^2, w = nobs - 2))
  # trial_noise  <- sqrt(pooled_sigma2)
  
  
  trial_noise_by_c1 <- per %>%group_by(c1) %>% summarise(
    pooled_sigma2 = weighted.mean(sigma^2, w = nobs - 2),
    trial_noise   = sqrt(pooled_sigma2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  trial_noise_c1_0 <- trial_noise_by_c1$trial_noise[trial_noise_by_c1$c1 == 0]
  trial_noise_c1_1 <- trial_noise_by_c1$trial_noise[trial_noise_by_c1$c1 == 1]

  # between-subject variance of slopes by condition
  bsd <- per %>% group_by(c1) %>% summarise(between_sd = sd(estimate), .groups = "drop")
  bsd_c1_0 <- bsd$between_sd[bsd$c1 == 0]
  bsd_c1_1 <- bsd$between_sd[bsd$c1 == 1]

  tibble(
    method        = "Sample correlation",
    t_r           = rho,
    I             = nrow(wide),
    L             = n_per,   # for low_snr L is 1000, I is 100
    e_r           = unname(ct$estimate),
    r_lo_95       = ct$conf.int[1],
    r_up_95       = ct$conf.int[2],
    # trial_noise   = trial_noise,
    trial_noise_c1_0 = trial_noise_c1_0,
    trial_noise_c1_1 = trial_noise_c1_1,
    bsd_c1_0      = bsd_c1_0,
    bsd_c1_1      = bsd_c1_1,
    varX          = varX,
  )
})

naive_df
View(naive_df)

analyt_df <- naive_df %>%
  mutate(
    method = "Analytic correction",
    SNR1 = (bsd_c1_1 / trial_noise_c1_1)^2 - 1 / ((L-1) * varX),
    SNR2 = (bsd_c1_0 / trial_noise_c1_0)^2 - 1 / ((L-1) * varX),
    att_factor = sqrt((SNR1 / (SNR1 + 1 / (varX * (L-1)))) * (SNR2 / (SNR2 + 1 / (varX * (L-1))))),
    exp_factor = 1 / att_factor,
    cr = e_r * exp_factor,
    cr_lo_95 = exp_factor * tanh(atanh(e_r) - 1.96 / sqrt(I - 3)),
    cr_up_95 = exp_factor * tanh(atanh(e_r) + 1.96 / sqrt(I - 3))
  ) %>%
  mutate(cr = pmax(pmin(cr, 1), -1),
    cr_lo_95 = pmax(pmin(cr_lo_95, 1), -1),
    cr_up_95 = pmax(pmin(cr_up_95, 1), -1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(method, t_r, I, L, cr, cr_lo_95, cr_up_95,
               bsd_c1_0, bsd_c1_1, varX) %>%
  rename(e_r = cr, r_lo_95 = cr_lo_95, r_up_95 = cr_up_95)
View(analyt_df)
```

```{r}
# ---- compute per-subject, per-condition slope ----
slope_xy <- function(x, y) {
  vx <- var(x)
  if (is.na(vx) || vx <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  cov(x, y) / vx
  # # alternative:
  # coef(lm(y ~ x))[2]
}

compute_corr_from_dat <- function(dat, x_col = "pred") {
  slopes <- dat %>%
    mutate(cond = if_else(c1 == 1, "c1", "c2")) %>%
    group_by(subj_id, cond) %>%
    summarise(
      slope = slope_xy(.data[[x_col]], y),
      .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cond, values_from = slope, names_sort = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup()

  # correlation across subjects (pairwise complete to drop any NA)
  r <- cor(slopes$c1, slopes$c2, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  list(
    r = r,
    n_pairs = sum(complete.cases(slopes$c1, slopes$c2)),
    slopes = slopes
  )
}

files <- list.files("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/data", pattern = "^dat_rho_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
results <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  dat <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  out <- compute_corr_from_dat(dat)
  tibble(
    file = basename(f),
    rho_label = sub("^dat_rho_(.*)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(f)),
    n_pairs = out$n_pairs,
    r_hat = out$r
  )
}) %>% arrange(rho_label)

print(results)
```

```{r}

rho_vals <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

get_par <- function(summ, pattern) {
  rn <- rownames(summ)
  i  <- grep(pattern, rn)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(summ)))
  summ[i[1], ]
}

bs_df <- map_dfr(rho_vals, function(rho) {
  dat <- read.csv(sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/data/dat_rho_%s.csv", rho))
  varX <- sd(dat$pred)^2
  f <- sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/model/simulation_rel_%s.rds", rho)
  m <- read_rds(f)

  S <- posterior_summary(m)  # columns: Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5

  # Try canonical brms names first; fall back to broad regex if needed
  cor_row <- get_par(S, "^cor_subj_id__pred:c1__pred:c2$|cor.*pred:c1.*pred:c2")
  sd_c1_1 <- get_par(S, "^sd_subj_id__pred:c1$|sd.*pred:c1$")
  sd_c1_0 <- get_par(S, "^sd_subj_id__pred:c2$|sd.*pred:c2$")
  sig_row <- get_par(S, "^sigma$")

  tibble(
    method        = "Bayesian hierarchical",
    t_r           = rho,
    I             = N_subj,
    L             = n_per,
    e_r           = unname(cor_row["Estimate"]),
    r_lo_95       = unname(cor_row["Q2.5"]),
    r_up_95       = unname(cor_row["Q97.5"]),
    trial_noise   = round(unname(sig_row["Estimate"]), 2),
    bsd_c1_0      = round(unname(sd_c1_0["Estimate"]), 4), 
    bsd_c1_1      = round(unname(sd_c1_1["Estimate"]), 4),
    varX          = varX
  )
})

bs_df

rho_vals <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

blup_df <- map_dfr(rho_vals, function(rho) {
  dat <- read.csv(sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/data/dat_rho_%s.csv", rho))
  varX <- sd(dat$pred)^2
  f <- sprintf("../simulation/I100l1000_lowSNR/model/simulation_rel_%s.rds", rho)
  m <- readr::read_rds(f)
  S  <- brms::posterior_summary(m)
  rn <- rownames(S)

  # grab per-level BLUPs for pred:c1 and pred:c2 (tolerate c1:pred order)
  i_c1 <- grep("^r_subj_id\\[.*,(pred:c1|c1:pred)\\]$", rn)
  i_c2 <- grep("^r_subj_id\\[.*,(pred:c2|c2:pred)\\]$", rn)

  subj_from <- function(x, pat) sub(pat, "\\1", x)
  subj_c1 <- subj_from(rn[i_c1], "^r_subj_id\\[(.*?),(?:pred:c1|c1:pred)\\]$")
  subj_c2 <- subj_from(rn[i_c2], "^r_subj_id\\[(.*?),(?:pred:c2|c2:pred)\\]$")

  blup_c1 <- tibble(subj_id=subj_c1, val=S[i_c1, "Estimate"])
  blup_c2 <- tibble(subj_id=subj_c2, val=S[i_c2, "Estimate"])

  wide <- full_join(blup_c1, blup_c2, by="subj_id", suffix=c("_c1","_c2")) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(val_c1, val_c2)
  ct <- cor.test(wide$val_c1, wide$val_c2, method="pearson")
  sig_est <- S[rownames(S) == "sigma", "Estimate"]
  trial_noise <- if (length(sig_est)) round(unname(sig_est), 2) else NA_real_

  tibble(method = "Bayesian BLUP",
    t_r = rho,
    I = nrow(wide),
    L = n_per,
    e_r = unname(ct$estimate),
    r_lo_95 = unname(ct$conf.int[1]),
    r_up_95 = unname(ct$conf.int[2]),
    trial_noise = trial_noise,
    bsd_c1_0 = round(sd(wide$val_c2), 4), 
    bsd_c1_1 = round(sd(wide$val_c1), 4),
    varX = varX
    )
  })

blup_df
```

```{r}
  labs(
    x = "True Reliability",
    y = "Estimated Reliability with 95% CI/CrI",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(1, 0.05),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.1), color = NA),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
  )

  ggsave(filename = paste0("../visualization/paper/simulation/methods_comparison_I100l1000.pdf"), width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
  

```
